node.title: Exact low-field rate-half threshold and post-cutoff bracket
node.statement: For the official n=2^41,k=2^40 rate-half row, let r_Q=389,500,552,608 and B_Q=r_Q+1. For every admissible field with B=floor(q/2^128)<=B_Q, the exact adjacent certificate is B_mca(n-B+1)=B<B_mca(n-B), the latter numerator being at least B+1. Thus every admissible q<(B_Q+1)2^128, approximately 2^166.502834419, is completely determined. More generally, for 1<=B<=k-1, n-B+1<=a_RH(q)<=n-min(B-1,r_Q). When B_Q<B<=2^39+1, safety at the lower candidate is equivalent to the single far-CA bound B_ca^far(n-B+1)<=B because its sparse numerator is already at most B-1.
